HomePage.commitP1: Because Welqo is a boutique concierge company in its launch phase in Hauts-de-France, we make the strong choice of quality over quantity.
HomePage.commitP2: We only accept a limited number of new property owners each quarter. Why? To guarantee that every property we manage benefits from direct, daily attention from our founders, impeccable maintenance, and authentic 5★ hospitality for your guests.
HomePage.pricingSubtitle: Our fees are indexed on your income. We only make money when you do.
HomePage.faq_0_q: How much does Airbnb concierge cost in Hauts-de-France with Welqo?
HomePage.faq_0_a: Welqo operates on a commission-only model (between 15% and 20% of gross revenue depending on the scope of services). No fixed fees, no surprises. You only pay Welqo when you earn money.
HomePage.faq_1_q: Can I continue to use my property myself?
HomePage.faq_1_a: Absolutely. You retain full access to your owner calendar via your dashboard. Block your personal dates in a few clicks, we manage the rest without interruption of service.
HomePage.faq_2_q: How long before my property is listed?
HomePage.faq_2_a: On average 5 to 7 working days between our first visit and going live. We handle everything: photo shoot, copywriting, Airbnb onboarding, town hall declaration.
HomePage.faq_3_q: What happens in the event of damage by a guest?
HomePage.faq_3_a: Your property is protected by our rigorous inventory + the Airbnb AirCover guarantee (up to €3M). We manage the entire dispute on your behalf: declaration, follow-up, reimbursement.
HomePage.faq_4_q: Does Welqo only cover Lille intra-muros?
HomePage.faq_4_a: No. We cover the entire Lille metropolitan area: Lille, Roubaix, Tourcoing, Villeneuve-d'Ascq, Lomme, Lesquin (airport proximity) and Marcq-en-Barœul.
HomePage.faq_5_q: Am I tied to a long-term contract?
HomePage.faq_5_a: Our model has no duration commitment. You are free to terminate at any time with 30 days' notice. We rely on performance to keep you, not contractual clauses.

LogementsPage.heroSubtitle: Welqo selects exceptional properties across Northern France to manage and showcase on the best short-term rental platforms.
LogementsPage.coverageSubtitle: We operate across the entire region
LogementsPage.qualitySubtitle: We don't manage every property. Each partner property goes through an on-site audit to ensure a level of excellence compatible with our hotel standard.
LogementsPage.auditDesc: Within 48 hours, we analyze your property, estimate your potential income, and propose a concrete action plan. Free, no commitment.
LogementsPage.faq_0_q: How do I book a stay with Welqo?
LogementsPage.faq_0_a: Simply select your dates and number of guests on the listing page of your choice, then complete your secure booking via our Stripe payment gateway.
LogementsPage.faq_1_q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
LogementsPage.faq_1_a: Check-in is generally from 4:00 PM and check-out is before 11:00 AM. Detailed access instructions (via secure lockbox or personal greeting) will be sent automatically 48 hours before your stay.
LogementsPage.faq_2_a: Yes, a security deposit pre-authorization is securely processed via Stripe during booking. No funds are debited from your account, unless damages are reported after check-out inspection.
LogementsPage.faq_3_q: What is the cancellation policy for stays?
LogementsPage.faq_3_a: Our standard policy allows 100% free cancellation up to 5 days before your arrival date. Specific policy details for each property can be reviewed on their description page before booking.
LogementsPage.faq_4_q: Are essential amenities (linen, towels, wifi) included?
LogementsPage.faq_4_a: Absolutely. All Welqo accommodations strictly comply with our 5-star excellence charter: hotel-quality bed linen and towels, high-speed Wi-Fi, starter kits, and professional cleaning before every stay.

LilleLandingPage.heroSubtitle: The short-term rental management expert in Lille. Professional photos, 5★ hotel cleaning, dynamic pricing adjusted for the Braderie de Lille and Grand Stade events.
LilleLandingPage.statsTitle: Airbnb profitability in Lille in figures
LilleLandingPage.districtsTitle: Airbnb management in all districts of Lille
LilleLandingPage.district_0_desc: Historic charm, high tourist demand and upscale listings.
LilleLandingPage.district_1_desc: Business district, ideal for business travel and short stays.
LilleLandingPage.district_2_desc: Student and residential, sought-after for its peaceful environment.
LilleLandingPage.district_3_desc: Popular and lively, strong cultural attraction on weekends.
LilleLandingPage.district_4_desc: Lille hyper-center, walking distance to shops and museums.
LilleLandingPage.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about Airbnb management in Lille
LilleLandingPage.faq_0_q: What are the short-term rental regulations in Lille?
LilleLandingPage.faq_0_a: In Lille, short-term rentals are limited to 120 days per year for a primary residence. For secondary residences, a change of use authorization is required. Welqo handles town hall registration and legal compliance for you.
LilleLandingPage.faq_1_q: How does Welqo optimize nightly rates in Lille?
LilleLandingPage.faq_1_a: Our dynamic pricing algorithm adjusts rates daily based on Lille metropolitan events: the Braderie de Lille, LOSC matches at the Decathlon Arena, Series Mania festival, or conventions at Lille Grand Palais.
LilleLandingPage.faq_2_q: Who handles cleaning and check-ins in Lille?
LilleLandingPage.faq_2_a: Our local teams in Lille handle professional 5★ hotel-grade cleaning, premium linen supply, and complete guest and key management 24/7.
LilleLandingPage.faq_3_q: Which Lille neighbourhoods are most profitable on Airbnb?
LilleLandingPage.faq_3_a: Vieux-Lille is the most profitable for leisure (€95–€120/night, 80%+ occupancy in peak season). Euralille and the station area are best for business travellers (€60–€80/night, stable Monday–Friday). Wazemmes and République offer a good return/acquisition price balance. Welqo tailors your pricing strategy to your specific neighbourhood.
LilleLandingPage.faq_4_q: How much can I expect to earn from my Lille apartment on Airbnb?
LilleLandingPage.faq_4_a: A well-located one-bedroom in Lille averages €1,400–€1,850 gross per month on Airbnb (78% occupancy, €95 average nightly rate). Event peaks (Braderie de Lille, LOSC, Series Mania) allow rates to triple a few nights per year. Our free simulator provides a personalised estimate in 2 minutes.

ProprietairesPage.heroSubtitle: Professional photos, 5★ hotel cleaning, dynamic pricing, 24/7 check-in and real-time dashboard. 20% commission — zero fixed fees, zero commitment.
ProprietairesPage.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions for property owners
ProprietairesPage.faq_0_q: How much does Welqo's Airbnb concierge cost?
ProprietairesPage.faq_0_a: Welqo operates on a commission-only model: 20% of the gross revenue generated by your property. No fixed fees, no subscription, no hidden costs. If your property generates no revenue, you pay nothing.
ProprietairesPage.faq_1_q: Can I still use my property for myself?
ProprietairesPage.faq_1_a: Absolutely. You retain full access to your calendar via your real-time owner dashboard. Block personal dates in a few clicks — we handle the rest without any service interruption.
ProprietairesPage.faq_2_q: How long does it take to get my property listed?
ProprietairesPage.faq_2_a: Typically, your property is live on Airbnb and other platforms within 7 business days of our initial visit: professional photo shoot, SEO-optimised listing, dynamic pricing setup and town hall registration.
ProprietairesPage.faq_3_q: Which cities do you cover in Northern France?
ProprietairesPage.faq_3_a: Welqo currently covers Lille, Lens, Arras, Béthune, Douai and their surrounding communes. We are progressively expanding across the Hauts-de-France region. Contact us to check if your property is eligible.
ProprietairesPage.faq_4_q: What happens if a guest causes damage?
ProprietairesPage.faq_4_a: Every booking includes a guest deposit managed via Airbnb. In addition, Welqo conducts a check-out inspection after each stay and guides you through the Airbnb claims process if any damage is noted.

LensLandingPage.heroSubtitle: The short-term rental management expert in Lens. Professional photos, 5★ hotel cleaning, dynamic pricing synced with RC Lens matches at Stade Bollaert and Louvre-Lens exhibitions.
LensLandingPage.statsTitle: Airbnb profitability in Lens in figures
LensLandingPage.districtsTitle: Airbnb management across the Bassin Minier
LensLandingPage.district_0_desc: Lively city heart, high demand on match nights and cultural weekends.
LensLandingPage.district_1_desc: Dynamic neighbouring town, ideal for sports and family stays.
LensLandingPage.district_2_desc: Walking distance from Stade Bollaert, very popular on RC Lens match days.
LensLandingPage.district_3_desc: UNESCO heritage slag heaps, attracts visitors on the mining circuit.
LensLandingPage.district_4_desc: Quiet residential area, good balance between accessibility and tranquillity.
LensLandingPage.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about Airbnb management in Lens
LensLandingPage.faq_0_q: Why rent your property on Airbnb in Lens rather than long-term?
LensLandingPage.faq_0_a: Short-term rentals in Lens generate 2 to 3 times more income than traditional rentals, thanks to seasonal demand linked to RC Lens matches (20 home games per season), Louvre-Lens exhibitions (700,000 visitors/year) and UNESCO Bassin Minier sites. Welqo automatically optimises your prices during these high-demand periods.
LensLandingPage.faq_1_q: How does Welqo manage demand peaks on RC Lens match days?
LensLandingPage.faq_1_a: Our dynamic pricing algorithm detects matches at Stade Bollaert up to 90 days in advance and adjusts your prices upward to maximise revenue. Match nights can reach 150 to 200% of the standard rate. We also manage late check-ins after evening games.
LensLandingPage.faq_2_q: Who handles cleaning and check-ins in Lens?
LensLandingPage.faq_2_a: Our local Bassin Minier teams provide professional 5★ hotel-grade cleaning, premium linen supply, and complete key and guest management 24/7. Our staff are based in Lens and surrounding areas for maximum responsiveness.
LensLandingPage.faq_3_q: How do RC Lens matches affect my Airbnb revenue?
LensLandingPage.faq_3_a: RC Lens plays approximately 17 home league matches per season, plus domestic cups and sometimes European fixtures. Each match generates 40–80% demand surges on standard rates, with peaks on northern derby days. Welqo sets dynamic pricing up to 90 days in advance to maximise every match night without ever leaving a property unbooked at the wrong price.
LensLandingPage.faq_4_q: Which areas of the Lens agglomeration are most in demand on Airbnb?
LensLandingPage.faq_4_a: Central Lens (near Stade Bollaert and Louvre-Lens) is the most in-demand area. Liévin (10 min walk from the stadium) is growing fast. Avion and Loos-en-Gohelle attract UNESCO slag heap visitors. For investment, prioritise within 15 min walk of the Louvre-Lens or Bollaert stadium.

ArrasLandingPage.heroSubtitle: The short-term rental management expert in Arras. Professional photos, 5★ hotel cleaning, dynamic pricing synced with memorial tourism, UNESCO Grand-Place and the Christmas market.
ArrasLandingPage.statsTitle: Airbnb profitability in Arras in figures
ArrasLandingPage.districtsTitle: Airbnb management in all districts of Arras
ArrasLandingPage.district_0_desc: UNESCO Grand-Place and Place des Héros, Arras's tourist heart, high demand year-round.
ArrasLandingPage.district_1_desc: Residential neighbourhood close to the centre, ideal for families and memorial tourists.
ArrasLandingPage.district_2_desc: Quiet adjacent town, appreciated for its calm and quick access to the city centre.
ArrasLandingPage.district_3_desc: Southern residential area of Arras, easy access to Wellington Quarry and the Western Front sites.
ArrasLandingPage.district_4_desc: Southern entry to the agglomeration, popular with visitors to the Vimy Memorial and battlefields.
ArrasLandingPage.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about Airbnb management in Arras
ArrasLandingPage.faq_0_q: What are Arras's tourism assets for short-term rental?
ArrasLandingPage.faq_0_a: Arras has exceptional heritage generating a constant flow of tourists: the UNESCO Grand-Place and Place des Héros, Wellington Quarry (100,000 visitors/year), Vimy Memorial (400,000 visitors/year), the Christmas market (200,000 visitors) and numerous Centenary commemorations. These events create strong seasonal demand that Welqo capitalises on through dynamic pricing.
ArrasLandingPage.faq_1_q: How does Welqo optimise nightly rates in Arras?
ArrasLandingPage.faq_1_a: Our dynamic pricing algorithm adjusts rates daily based on Arras's tourism calendar: Armistice commemorations, Christmas market opening weekends, events at the Arras Citadel, and French and British school holidays (Arras has a strong UK visitor base).
ArrasLandingPage.faq_2_q: Who handles cleaning and check-ins in Arras?
ArrasLandingPage.faq_2_a: Our local Arras teams provide professional 5★ hotel-grade cleaning, premium linen supply, and complete key and guest management 24/7. We also offer a tourist concierge service for your guests (visit recommendations, transport, restaurants).
ArrasLandingPage.faq_3_q: Does memorial tourism really drive Airbnb demand in Arras?
ArrasLandingPage.faq_3_a: Yes, significantly. Arras is at the heart of First World War memorial tourism: Vimy Memorial (400,000 visitors/year, mostly Canadian), Wellington Quarry, and Commonwealth cemeteries. This Anglo-Saxon clientele (British, Canadian, Australian) generates strong demand in spring and autumn — off-peak for other destinations. Welqo adapts your listing language and descriptions to meet this audience's expectations.
ArrasLandingPage.faq_4_q: How much can my Arras property earn on Airbnb?
ArrasLandingPage.faq_4_a: A well-located one-bedroom in Arras historic centre earns on average €900–€1,050 gross per month (68% occupancy, €70 average nightly rate). The Christmas market (December) and Armistice commemorations (November) enable peaks of €100–€130/night. Our free simulator gives you a personalised estimate for your specific property.

BethuneLandingPage.heroSubtitle: The short-term rental management expert in Béthune. Professional photos, 5★ hotel cleaning, dynamic pricing. At the crossroads of Lille, Lens and Arras, Béthune is a growing short-term rental market.
BethuneLandingPage.statsTitle: Airbnb profitability in Béthune in figures
BethuneLandingPage.districtsTitle: Airbnb management in Béthune and surroundings
BethuneLandingPage.district_0_desc: UNESCO Belfry, lively Grand-Place and bustling town centre. Strong tourist appeal.
BethuneLandingPage.district_1_desc: Second town of the agglomeration, mining heritage and professional demand (construction, industry).
BethuneLandingPage.district_2_desc: Popular residential town known for its quality of life, ideal for family stays.
BethuneLandingPage.district_3_desc: Active town with its own stadium, attracts sports enthusiasts and business travellers.
BethuneLandingPage.district_4_desc: Quiet residential area on the outskirts of Béthune, good balance between tranquillity and accessibility.
BethuneLandingPage.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about Airbnb management in Béthune
BethuneLandingPage.faq_0_q: Why rent your property on Airbnb in Béthune?
BethuneLandingPage.faq_0_a: Béthune benefits from a strategic location at the heart of Hauts-de-France, 30 minutes from Lille, 20 minutes from Lens and 40 minutes from Arras. This accessibility attracts professional travellers (construction, industrial assignments), tourists (UNESCO Belfry, mining heritage) and sports fans. Airbnb competition is still low, representing a real opportunity for property owners.
BethuneLandingPage.faq_1_q: How does Welqo optimise nightly rates in Béthune?
BethuneLandingPage.faq_1_a: Our dynamic pricing algorithm adjusts rates based on local events (Béthune festivals, carnival, trade fairs), demand peaks linked to RC Lens matches 20 km away, and industrial project periods generating extended professional demand.
BethuneLandingPage.faq_2_q: Who handles cleaning and check-ins in Béthune?
BethuneLandingPage.faq_2_a: Our local Béthune and Artois teams provide professional 5★ hotel-grade cleaning, premium linen supply, and complete key and guest management 24/7. Our network covers Béthune, Bruay-la-Buissière, Barlin and Noeux-les-Mines.
BethuneLandingPage.faq_3_q: Is Béthune a good short-term rental market?
BethuneLandingPage.faq_3_a: Béthune is an underestimated market with real potential. Its location at the crossroads of Lille (40 km), Lens (20 km) and Arras (35 km) makes it a base for visitors exploring the region. Airbnb competition is still limited (fewer than 60 active listings), making top-10 positioning easier. Properties cost 30–50% less than in Lille for comparable returns.
BethuneLandingPage.faq_4_q: What is the impact of the UNESCO belfry on tourism in Béthune?
BethuneLandingPage.faq_4_a: Béthune's belfry has been on the UNESCO World Heritage list since 2005 (Belfries of Belgium and France). This label attracts cultural tourists in transit between Flemish heritage sites. The Grand-Place, summer carnival and annual markets also generate visitor peaks — all integrated into Welqo's dynamic pricing algorithm.

VieuxLilleLandingPage.heroSubtitle: The most sought-after neighbourhood in the Lille metropolitan area. Welqo maximises your revenue and manages your property on your behalf.
VieuxLilleLandingPage.statsTitle: Vieux-Lille Airbnb potential by the numbers
VieuxLilleLandingPage.district_0_desc: Iconic cobbled street, designer boutiques and gourmet restaurants. Very high demand at weekends and during school holidays.
VieuxLilleLandingPage.district_1_desc: Lively area, steps from the markets and the Chicorée brasserie. Ideal for short cultural stays.
VieuxLilleLandingPage.district_2_desc: Historic street linking Vieux-Lille to the Grand-Place. High tourist footfall year-round.
VieuxLilleLandingPage.district_3_desc: Authentic Vieux-Lille atmosphere, Flemish brick buildings, premium clientele.
VieuxLilleLandingPage.district_4_desc: Heritage area close to the Hospice Comtesse Museum, very popular with cultural tourists.
VieuxLilleLandingPage.faqTitle: FAQs about Airbnb management in Vieux-Lille
VieuxLilleLandingPage.faq_0_q: Is Vieux-Lille subject to the Airbnb 120-night rule?
VieuxLilleLandingPage.faq_0_a: Yes. If the property is your primary residence, you are limited to 120 rental nights per year. Beyond that, a change-of-use authorisation is required. Welqo tracks this quota and handles all administrative steps to keep you compliant.
VieuxLilleLandingPage.faq_1_q: What types of guests stay in Vieux-Lille?
VieuxLilleLandingPage.faq_1_a: Vieux-Lille mainly attracts premium leisure travellers (couples, groups of friends), visitors to the Braderie and flea markets, cultural event attendees (Lille 3000, opera, museums) and business travellers seeking an authentic experience.
VieuxLilleLandingPage.faq_2_q: What is Welqo's fee for Airbnb management in Vieux-Lille?
VieuxLilleLandingPage.faq_2_a: Welqo charges a 20% commission on gross revenue, with no fixed fees or commitment. This covers full management: multi-platform listings, dynamic pricing, guest reception, professional cleaning and monthly reporting.

WazemmeesLandingPage.heroSubtitle: Lille's most vibrant and multicultural neighbourhood. Strong Airbnb potential for owners who want to delegate.
WazemmeesLandingPage.statsTitle: Wazemmes Airbnb potential by the numbers
WazemmeesLandingPage.district_0_desc: The heart of the neighbourhood. The Sunday market draws thousands of visitors every weekend, guaranteeing strong Airbnb visibility.
WazemmeesLandingPage.district_1_desc: Lively commercial street linking Wazemmes to central Lille. Good accessibility, mixed demand (tourism + professional).
WazemmeesLandingPage.district_2_desc: Residential area popular with young professionals and students looking for affordable short-stay accommodation.
WazemmeesLandingPage.district_3_name: Around Place de la Nouvelle Aventure
WazemmeesLandingPage.district_3_desc: Area undergoing rehabilitation, gradual gentrification, ideal for an investment anticipating long-term value appreciation.
WazemmeesLandingPage.district_4_desc: Demand from healthcare staff and patients travelling to the CHR generates a constant stream of mid-week bookings.
WazemmeesLandingPage.faqTitle: FAQs about Airbnb management in Wazemmes
WazemmeesLandingPage.faq_0_q: Is Wazemmes a good neighbourhood for Airbnb investment?
WazemmeesLandingPage.faq_0_a: Yes, Wazemmes offers an excellent price-to-yield ratio. Acquisition prices are 20–30% lower than Vieux-Lille for comparable Airbnb revenues. The Sunday market, neighbourhood life and proximity to the CHR guarantee diverse, year-round demand.
WazemmeesLandingPage.faq_1_q: How does Welqo maximise revenue in Wazemmes?
WazemmeesLandingPage.faq_1_a: We apply dynamic pricing that captures Wazemmes market peaks (Sundays, public holidays), Lille 3000 events, sports tournaments and Grand Palais trade fairs. Multi-platform listings (Airbnb + Booking.com) maximise occupancy rate.
WazemmeesLandingPage.faq_2_q: Does Welqo manage properties in Wazemmes and the rest of Lille?
WazemmeesLandingPage.faq_2_a: Welqo covers the entire Lille metropolitan area: Vieux-Lille, Wazemmes, Euralille, Centre, Fives and Hellemmes. Our local team is available 24/7 for check-ins, cleaning and emergency call-outs.

EuralilleLandingPage.heroSubtitle: Lille's business district, steps from the station. Premium corporate clientele and stable occupancy rates.
EuralilleLandingPage.statsTitle: Euralille Airbnb potential by the numbers
EuralilleLandingPage.district_0_desc: Around the Euralille shopping centre, high footfall from visitors and professionals. Excellent TGV accessibility.
EuralilleLandingPage.district_1_desc: Modern residential extension, new-build apartments favoured by corporate guests on extended stays.
EuralilleLandingPage.district_2_desc: Euralille's most strategic micro-area: a 5-minute walk from both Lille TGV stations.
EuralilleLandingPage.district_3_desc: Redeveloped waterfront area, contemporary architecture, highly rated by business travellers.
EuralilleLandingPage.district_4_desc: Congresses, trade fairs and events at Grand Palais generate significant demand spikes concentrated on specific dates.
EuralilleLandingPage.faqTitle: FAQs about Airbnb management in Euralille
EuralilleLandingPage.faq_0_q: Why is Euralille ideal for corporate guests?
EuralilleLandingPage.faq_0_a: Euralille is Lille's business hub: two TGV stations (Lille-Flandres and Lille-Europe) with direct connections to Paris, London and Brussels, the Grand Palais hosting hundreds of congresses annually, and a network of headquarters and international companies. Corporate clients book mid-week at rates above leisure travellers.
EuralilleLandingPage.faq_1_q: Does the Grand Palais really generate revenue peaks?
EuralilleLandingPage.faq_1_a: Yes. During major trade fairs (textiles, agri-food, medical) and events at the Grand Palais, Airbnb demand in Euralille can double or triple. Welqo anticipates these events with pre-programmed dynamic pricing to maximise revenue per night during these windows.
EuralilleLandingPage.faq_2_q: What is the difference between Euralille and Vieux-Lille for Airbnb?
EuralilleLandingPage.faq_2_a: Vieux-Lille is the choice of leisure travellers (weekends, cultural tourism) with rate peaks on Friday-Saturday. Euralille is the choice of corporate clients (Monday-Friday), more stable and less seasonal. A balanced portfolio with properties in both neighbourhoods delivers the best annual revenue consistency.

CalculateurPage.faq_2_q: Does the calculator cover all cities in Hauts-de-France?

CalculateurPage.faq_3_q: What is the difference between gross and net yield?

DouaiLandingPage.district_0_desc: The historic heart of Douai with the UNESCO belfry, Grand-Place and law courts. Ideal for cultural travellers and short tourist stays.

DouaiLandingPage.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about Airbnb management in Douai
DouaiLandingPage.faq_0_q: Does the Gayant festival impact Airbnb revenue in Douai?
DouaiLandingPage.faq_0_a: Yes, significantly. The Gayant festival (early July) is one of Northern France's great folk gatherings. During this period, demand for accommodation in Douai can increase by 40 to 60%. Welqo anticipates these peaks with pre-programmed dynamic pricing to maximise revenue per night.
DouaiLandingPage.faq_1_q: Is Douai a good city to invest in short-term rental?
DouaiLandingPage.faq_1_a: Douai offers an excellent acquisition price/potential yield ratio. Properties here cost 30 to 50% less than in Lille while maintaining decent occupancy. The UNESCO belfry, proximity to Lens (20km) and Arras (30km) generate a regular tourist flow. Welqo can carry out a free yield audit for your specific property.
DouaiLandingPage.faq_2_q: Does Welqo really operate in Douai?
DouaiLandingPage.faq_2_a: Yes. Welqo covers Douai and the greater Douaisis area. Our on-site teams are based in Hauts-de-France and respond within 2 hours for any incident. You benefit from the same service level as in Lille, Lens or Arras.
DouaiLandingPage.faq_3_q: Does the Gayant festival really impact Airbnb revenue in Douai?
DouaiLandingPage.faq_3_a: Yes, it is one of the most impactful events in the region. The Gayant festival (July, 4 days) attracts 50,000 to 80,000 visitors. Hotels sell out by May. Well-positioned Airbnb properties can reach €150–€200/night during this period — double or triple the usual rate. Welqo schedules dynamic price increases from the moment reservations open to maximise revenue on this event.
DouaiLandingPage.faq_4_q: Is it worth investing in Douai for short-term rental?
DouaiLandingPage.faq_4_a: The price/yield ratio in Douai is excellent. A central one-bedroom can be acquired for €80,000–€130,000 (40–60% cheaper than Lille) while generating €700–€900/month in Airbnb revenue. Gross yield before charges often reaches 7–10%, among the best in the region. Airbnb competition is still low, making it easy to build a strong review profile quickly.
